sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, face a home fixture against Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach come into this match off the back of a recent loss but remain in commanding form with seven wins from their last six games overall. Alsager Town sit bottom of the table with just four points and are struggling badly, having won only once all season, making this a golden opportunity for Sandbach to bounce back and extend their advantage at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town at home on Saturday, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in what should be a closely contested mid-table battle. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) face Wednesfield Community away on Saturday before a midweek trip to face Brereton Social at home on Wednesday—a demanding double that could define their week. In-form Bilston Town (5th) host Foley Meir at home on Saturday, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United; Shawbury are in freefall with five consecutive losses. New Mills travel to high-flying Market Drayton Town on Saturday. Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads in a basement clash between two of the division's poorest performers, while Crewe host Allscott Heath at home on Saturday. Widnes Town, bottom with just two points, travel to Brereton Social on Saturday in another fixture involving teams battling near the relegation zone.
